Much of my work is written for policymakers. I was lead author of two World Bank Global Financial Development Reports and have written analyses for the European Parliament's Economic and Monetary Affairs Committee. My policy work, columns and press coverage are below.

## Policy work

- **Lead author, World Bank *Global Financial Development Report*** 2017/2018 (*Bankers without Borders*) and 2019/2020 (bank regulation and supervision a decade after the global financial crisis).
- **In-depth analyses for the European Parliament's Economic and Monetary Affairs Committee** (with Harry Huizinga), 2015–2024, on bank profitability, NPL resolution, digital transformation, fit-and-proper rules and banking market integration.
- **SIEPS European Policy Analysis** on gender equality and regional growth in the EU, 2026.
- Consulting for the World Bank (including the Global Financial Development Analytics project), the EBRD and the Inter-American Development Bank.

Full list under [Research](research.qmd#policy-reports-and-book-chapters).
